Before you call

Helpful to know

What details should I send?

Where the site is, what work is planned, dates, crew size, and anything you’ve seen — crocodile sightings, snake activity or other wildlife. Photos help.

How quickly will you get back to me?

Promptly. Tell us about your project or operational environment and Chris will be in touch — or call 0409 326 307 for anything urgent.

Do you work on remote sites?

Yes — we service projects across the NT, WA and QLD, including remote and fly-in sites.

Specialist wildlife-risk management for government and industry across the NT, WA and QLD.
